use default

let limit = 1_000_000
let is_prime = LIST(limit + 1)

for _ in 0::limit do
    is_prime.add(true)
od

is_prime[0] = false
is_prime[1] = false

for candidate in 2::limit do
    if is_prime[candidate] /\ candidate <= limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple <= limit do
            is_prime[multiple] = false
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

goldbach(even: int) -> int =>
    (2::even / 2)
        |> filter(p => is_prime[p] /\ is_prime[even - p])
        |> count()

write_line("the first 100 G numbers:")

for row in 0..10 do
    let cells = (0..10)
        |> map(column => "{goldbach(4 + 2 * (row * 10 + column)),3}")

    write_line(cells |> join(" "))
od

write_line("G(1000000) = {goldbach(limit)}")
